name: Salmon
siboNotes: Salmon is FODMAP-free and an excellent choice for SIBO. It provides anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids which may help with gut healing. Fresh, canned, or smoked are all safe.

Canned salmon is convenient and safe
Smoked salmon is also low FODMAP
